Neutral: reads (including lookAround, exploreFrontier and survey), chat, plan changes, memory updates, or tool selection alone never earn good; a read followed by a concrete sensible search action can. Do not infer absence from the sampled block/entity lists or invent chest contents, ore yields, a safe drop, or an attackable golem.
